items.html: And this is the order of their division: four ways are drawn along the right cheek, aligned opposite it above in the skull, on that side of the right cheek; and four other ways in the skull, opposite the side of the left cheek; and four other ways in the skull, opposite the nape, at the back of the head. Thus they are twelve ways. And this is what is said there in the Idra, page 128, side B: "Engraved to the four sides of one direction..." And there is one more white path above, at the top of the skull, which includes them all, and together with it they are thirteen white ways.
